dataDescriptor.dataDescriptorLabel: Data Descriptor for Forest Product Auction
dataDescriptor.description: Details of forest product auctioned lots including product type, depot, quantity, and bidding values.

refNumber.description: Reference number associated with this auction event.

circleName.description: Circle name relevant to the auction context.

divisionName.description: Division name responsible for the auction.

rangeName.description: Range name associated with the product auction.

depotName.description: Depot name where the product is stored or auctioned.

lotNumber.description: Lot number identifying the auction lot.

productName.description: Name of the product being auctioned.

quantity.description: Quantity of the product available for auction.

biddingAmount.description: Bidding amount for the product auction.

auctionDate.description: Date and time of the auction event.
